item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q014_paper_example_reclassification_pa1492","answer":"In SCOP 1.69, PA1492 from PDB 1t1j was not classified with nucleoside 2-deoxyribosyltransferase from PDB 1f8y. PA1492 domains d1t1ja_ and d1t1jb_ were assigned to c.137.1.1: a separate PA1492 family, superfamily, and fold, under the alpha/beta class c. 1f8y domains d1f8ya_ and d1f8yb_ were assigned to c.23.14.1, the N-deoxyribosyltransferase family within the N-deoxyribosyltransferase superfamily and Flavodoxin-like fold. In the current SCOPe release discovered from the API, 2.08, PA1492 has been reclassified into the same superfamily and fold as 1f8y: 1t1j A/B are now c.23.14.2, family Hypothetical protein PA1492, under superfamily c.23.14 N-(deoxy)ribosyltransferase-like and fold c.23 Flavodoxin-like. 1f8y remains c.23.14.1, family N-deoxyribosyltransferase. Thus the relationship changed from no SCOP superfamily/fold relationship in 1.69, beyond the broad alpha/beta class, to a same-superfamily/same-fold relationship in SCOPe 2.08. They are still different families, so family-level homology, enzymatic function transfer, or using 1f8y as a close template for PA1492 should not be assumed solely from SCOPe placement; the supported inference is more conservative: remote evolutionary/structural relationship at the superfamily level, not identity of function or close family membership.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/","/api/v1/releases","/api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1t1j","/api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1f8y","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1t1j","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1f8y","/api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1t1j/domains","/api/v1/releases/1.69/pdb/1f8y/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1t1j/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1f8y/domains","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1t1ja1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1f8ya_","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1t1ja_","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1f8ya_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/110463","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52312","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sunids/110463","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sunids/52312","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/110462","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52311","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sunids/110462","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sunids/52311","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/110461","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52310","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sunids/110461","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sunids/52310","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52309","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sunids/52309","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sunids/110460","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/52171","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sunids/52171","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sunids/110459","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51349","/api/v1/releases/1.69/sunids/51349"]}]}
